verdict.rationale: Skyfire ships an MCP server exposing tools (find-sellers, create-kya-token, create-pay-token, create-kya-payment-token) that let an LLM-driven agent translate natural-language requests into commerce actions like discovering sellers and issuing/charging tokens, which is the standard mechanism for natural-language operation in agentic products. Missing for 10: no evidence of a first-party conversational interface, no examples of actual natural-language prompts mapped to tool calls, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of NL-driven usage beyond the docs.
